svg.text: * THIS DRAWING AND ALL ENCLOSURES ARE THE
PROPERTY OF THE COMPANY AND ARE ENTRUSTED TO
THE RECIPIENT PERSONALLY. THEY SHALL NOT BE
COPIED, REPRODUCED OR DISCLOSED TO A THIRD
PARTY WITHOUT WRITTEN CONSENT. * IF IN DOUBT
A Analysis (composition, e.g. O2, CO, H2)
K Time, time schedule (Time rate of change)
X Unclassified (define on legend; here XV = on/off shutdown
Z Driver, actuator, final control element
PREFIX = equipment type letters; A = plant area digit (4 = area 400); NN = running number in the area
LETTERS = ISA-5.1 function letters; A = area digit; LLL = loop number. All devices of one loop share the number (FT-4026, FIC-4026
Hand valve with its own running number
Takes the loop number of its controller; first letter = controlled variable (F, T, P, L)
On/off actuated valve operated by a trip
Pressure safety valve on equipment or line
Nominal size - service code - sequence (area digit + number) - pipe spec - insulation code
Chutes, screws and conveyors carry no pipe size or spec
HH and LL are trip levels (safety system); H and L are alarms
100 feed and pyrolysis; 200 condensing; 300 solids handling; 400 gasification and syngas cleaning; 500 power
Transmitter measures, controller compares with set point, valve acts
Dashed = instrument signal; red dashed = safety trip
State fail-closed or fail-open for every actuated valve (not yet assigned in this draft)
CONTROL CONVENTION: circle / barred circle / diamond
Field instrument / DCS function / safety function
R = Reactor E = Heat exchanger TK = Tank or bin H = Hopper SC = Screw conveyor / feeder CY = Cyclone F = Filter
B = Blower S = Separator FL = Flare CT = Cooling tower PK = Vendor package U = Utility header
1. SYMBOLS DRAWN FROM GENERAL KNOWLEDGE OF ANSI/ISA-5.1 AND COMMON ISO 10628 / PIP PIC001 PRACTICE;
NOT COPIED FROM THE STANDARDS. CHECK AGAINST THE COMPANY LEGEND BEFORE ISSUE.
2. ASME DOES NOT DEFINE P&ID SYMBOLS; ASME B31.3 / B16 / BPVC VIII GOVERN THE PIPING, VALVE AND VESSEL DESIGN BEHIND THEM.
3. ON THE P&ID: FIELD INSTRUMENT = CIRCLE; DCS FUNCTION = CIRCLE IN SQUARE; SAFETY FUNCTION = DIAMOND IN SQUARE.
